summary: The blueprint is broadly plausible for human whole pancreas but needs targeted refinement for redundant acinar/ductal axes, immune subtype resolution, and a few coverage/marker issues.

issues.description: The two acinar/ductal contrast axes are exact reciprocals, adding dimensionality without adding biological resolution, and acinar identity is not represented as a clean plain identity axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the reciprocal pair with non-redundant epithelial axes, such as a plain acinar_identity axis and a plain or single contrast ductal_identity/ductal_vs_acinar axis. Do not keep both exact inverse contrasts.

issues.description: T cells and NK cells are collapsed into one mixed module, blurring CD3+ T cells, NK cells, and cytotoxic lymphocyte states that are expected distinguishable populations in whole pancreas.
issues.suggested_fix: Split the module into separate T-cell and NK/cytotoxic modules and add separate immune-gated refinement axes, or add an additional gated refinement that separates CD3D/CD3E/TRAC/IL7R from NKG7/GNLY/PRF1/GZMB/KLRD1.

issues.description: B cells and plasma cells are collapsed into one module despite having distinct marker programs and expected roles in whole-tissue immune composition.
issues.suggested_fix: Split b_plasma_cell into B-cell and plasma-cell modules and add separate immune-gated refinement axes.

issues.description: Whole human pancreas samples can include adipocytes or adipose-associated stromal cells, but the blueprint has no adipocyte/lipid-storage module.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an adipocyte/lipid module and plain or stromal-gated axis using markers such as ADIPOQ, PLIN1, FABP4, LPL, CIDEA, LIPE, and DGAT2 if fuller whole-tissue coverage is desired.

issues.description: The centroacinar/ductal module mixes canonical ductal genes with injury or activated ductal markers such as SPP1, MMP7, and REG3A, which may bias the axis toward pancreatitis-like activation rather than healthy centroacinar identity.
issues.suggested_fix: Retune the module toward cleaner centroacinar/ductal markers such as KRT7, KRT19, SOX9, CFTR, HNF1B, SLC4A4, ANXA4, and MUC1; represent activated ductal stress separately only if intended.

out_of_scope: The rare endocrine epsilon axis is acceptable because age is unspecified; it would be less important for a strictly adult-only healthy pancreas scenario.
Generic cycling, interferon, ER stress, and immediate-early axes are reasonable as cross-lineage state dimensions for scRNA-seq data.
